left.source: linker-sim-assets d0224b8d arms/ar5_08/variants/left, derived by scripts/derive_ar5_08_arms.py

right.source: linker-sim-assets d0224b8d arms/ar5_08/variants/right, derived by scripts/derive_ar5_08_arms.py

deviations.field: left_arm.base_pose orientation / right_arm.base_pose orientation / home_q J1
deviations.ours: left rotated -84.10 deg, right +85.85 deg about each base z (J1) axis relative to the vendor mount (arm_base_rotation_deg). home_q J1 = base-scene home J1 + j1_offset_deg(scene base, teleop_calibration.json reference_base_orientation_wxyz), so the home pose stays where it was in the world.
deviations.evidence: Measured on the real station 2026-11-12: with both arms at q=(0,90,+/-90,0,0,0,0) a vertical tape from the table-front underside to the top of the last-joint housing read 500 mm (left) / 520 mm (right); the arm meshes put that at -84.10 / +85.85 deg (+/-0.44 deg for +/-5 mm). The scene used the original workstation values -90 / +105 until then; teleop was calibrated on those (reference_base_orientation_wxyz in configs/workcell/teleop_calibration.json) and configs/workcell/teleop_calibration.json shifts teleop J1 by the difference.

deviations.vendor: components/hands/linkerhand_l25 (same meshes; thumb_cmc_pitch origin, left finger roll axes, DIP mimic 0.7879 and limits differ)
deviations.ours: g20_pbr_description v0.1.1 = public linkerhand-urdf L25 parameters, as on the original workstation
deviations.evidence: Retargeting and the G20 motor mapping are built on the public parameters; user decision 2026-11-11 to keep them until a real-hand comparison.

deviations.ours: the scene table box with the same extents (vendor tabletop bounding box)
deviations.evidence: Representation only; the box keeps the table material and existing table handling. Extents are the vendor's.

not_taken_from_vendor: top_camera (workstation_zed2i): the station uses camera_3 (RealSense) with its own calibration
vendor collision_exclusions and whole-bench collision: our collision variants (gamepad-contact) are kept
vendor L25 white placeholder colours: our appearance file is kept
notes: Composed by scripts/vendor_bench_scene.py: vendor baseline (references/vendor_bench_baseline.json, linker-sim-assets d0224b8d ar5_08_l25_bench_bimanual) + deviations (configs/workcell/vendor_bench_overrides.json) + the gamepad_fixture_v3_3.json layers the vendor model lacks.

From the vendor: table extents (15 mm plate, top 767.2 mm), column (60 mm deep), mount plates and crossbar, frame/legs/casters/panels/shelves as collision parts, arm base positions, hand mounts (20.5 mm, +/-90 deg), arm models 08L/08R (J6/J7 +/-60 deg).
Station controllers report AR5-5_0.8L-W4C1C5 (left) and AR5-5_0.8R-W4C1C5 (right), 2026-11-11; at q=(0,90,+/-90,0,0,0,0) the controller flange pose equals the 08L/08R tcp FK.

Arm base orientation, hand models and every layer the vendor model lacks (gamepad, fixture v3.3, camera_3 and its calibration, home_q, floor, backdrop, appearance) are unchanged from gamepad_fixture_v3_3.json; see its notes for their provenance.
